title: Albert Bender's three men in black teleport him to Antarctica

tellings.quote: these three men in black materialized in his attic. And he said they had he said they had glowing orange eyes and they smelled like sulfur

plain: In the 1950s, a man named Albert Bender said three men in black, the dark-suited visitors said to call on UFO witnesses, appeared out of thin air in his attic, with glowing orange eyes and a smell of sulfur, and took him to Antarctica. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells it from Bender's own account, which he credits to a book he calls The Saucers and the Three Men. He brings it up because, if true, it would mean those visitors were not ordinary government agents but something able to move a person across the world.
